exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb-te itadakitai (would like you to do...)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞ていただきたい matches "Verb-te itadakitai (would like you to do...)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞ていただきたい.
exercises.explanation: Polite way to express wanting someone to do something for you.
